audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart rows 2, 4 and 6 disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys text.
audit.why: whys[2] describes a CS race neither side can commit in (Skill), whys[4] says 'you flip the lane right here' (Kayle at 6), whys[6] says he out-scales and to let the team peel him (Vladimir).
audit.corrected: Vladimir, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Vladimir — proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Vlad levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Vlad 2+ items with Rylai's.
audit.corrected: Unchanged; phase whys now match them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool was described only as 'dodges your burst' with no duration and no cooldown, and Tides of Blood's charge window was never given a number.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s and 2 seconds of untargetability — a 28s rank-1 cooldown is an enormous punish window and the reason baiting it wins the trade. Tides of Blood is 13/11/9/7/5s, so the empty-charge gap at rank 1 is 13s.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now stated in the cooldown breakdown, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appeared only in the itemization row; the trading and cooldown advice never mentioned it.
audit.why: Vladimir sustains through chip with Transfusion (Q, down to 4.6s) and heals off every champion hit by Hemoplague, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds now named in the cooldown breakdown, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vladimir must walk into your range.
edits.after: Neither of you can commit — his 28s Pool is not worth burning and your combo cannot beat his Q heal. A CS race.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vladimir's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R's invulnerability lets you kite Tides of Blood — the lane flips here. Get Grievous Wounds before any long trade.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool goes untargetable for 2s through your R nova and his drain out-scales you — close before that.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your burst. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — 28s at rank 1, 2s untargetable. Bait it, then commit. - Tides of Blood: 13s at rank 1 — step in on the empty charge. - Grievous Wounds before long trades.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 28s at rank 1 and 2s untargetable — bait the Pool, then commit.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Buy Grievous Wounds early — Transfusion heals every trade back.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His Rylai's plus second-item spike is real — CS is what beats it.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your burst. Bait it. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 2s untargetable — bait it. Grievous Wounds beats his Q heal.

edits.before: Wave-by-wave: farm safe, E-poke Vladimir when his answer is down, and let levels 6 and 11 renegotiate the lane.
edits.after: Wave-by-wave: farm safe, Q-poke Vladimir when Tides of Blood is empty, and let 6 and 11 renegotiate the lane.

notes: Kayle ability names in currentText (Radiant Blast, Divine Ascent, Starfire Spellblade, Divine Judgment, Celestial Blessing) match Riot data. Existing text claims Sanguine Pool 'dodges your R nova' — Riot's text confirms 2s untargetability, so the claim is supported and I reused it rather than rewriting. Tides of Blood is 'blocked by enemy units' per Riot's own description, i.e. minions body-block his poke; that is a real lane lever this page never mentions, but I could not fit it into any existing string inside the length band.
